sourceNote.why: All five MASTER_QUEUE rows carry sourceStatus CUSTOM_PLEADING_FROM_CODIFIED_TEXT with empty sourceHashes - there is no boundSource SHA-256 to verify per row. The legal-design intake record (data/record-clearing/legal-design-intake/DC.memo.json) states for each track that no official form exists and the statute fixes the motion's content; every packet-set manifest names one custom_pleading primary filing.

sharedReferenceInstrument.title: Superior Court of the District of Columbia, Criminal Division - How to Seal or Expunge Your Criminal Record (Rev. April 10, 2024)
sharedReferenceInstrument.verification: committed corpus-index SHA-256 + host-pinned SHA-256 + on-disk bytes + 19 printed-face anchors, verified on every build
sharedReferenceInstrument.role: the only DC document the Master Library holds; its verified face grounds the filing-channel steps, the Seal Team intake mailbox that assigns the motion its case number, and the help-organization list

sourceNote.sourceFidelityFinding: The intake memos state 'The court's instruction sheet states no fee'; the pinned sheet's face states nothing about fees. Every packet follows the face: nothing asserts filing is free, and fee/waiver are delegated to the Criminal Division clerk's office (202-879-1373) by name. Recorded in each family's build-findings.json and raised as a counsel question.

environmentNotes: The corpus is mounted at the main repo root, not inside this agent worktree; a symlink private/source-imports/Expungement_AI_RCAP_Master_Library_Edition_1 (gitignored) makes the default path resolve. master_library_mounted/complete/corpus_matches_committed_index all pass (499 files, 329 PDFs, 51 jurisdictions).

verify-packet-build-environment.mjs --family reports family_sources_bind FAIL for these families with 'names no resolved document source. An official_pdf_fill family with no bound source is not dispatchable.' That check reads the custody reconciliation, which carries zero documentSources for all five rows; the failure message is written for official_pdf_fill families. The MASTER_QUEUE rows - the dispatch authority for this task - say sourceBound true, ready true, directAttachment true, sourceStatus CUSTOM_PLEADING_FROM_CODIFIED_TEXT, and the captain dispatched the five families to build. Built on that authority; flagged here so the captain can teach the row gate about zero-source custom_pleading families.

Chromium resolves locally (PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH), so every page carries a local calibrated raster: RASTER_LOCAL_PENDING_CENTRAL, never a gate result. PASS_COMPLETE still requires the central hash-bound RASTER_PASS.
legalInputNote: MASTER_QUEUE dispatches all five families legalInputStatus SETTLED and every track's legalDesignDecision is legal_design_approved_with_limitations. The intake memos still carry open questions (Sept 11 2026 temporary-law expiry for the three 16-806 seal tracks, Master Grid mapping for conviction, product-scope enablement for innocence, oath formality for misattributed, prosecutor routing and filing channel for all). None is resolved by these builds; each travels in the family's approval-request.json counselQuestionsRaised, and each packet prints only recorded rules with named checkable authorities where no held source answers.
